Note: An error was expected inside an ASSERTERROR statement. BC's NavTestPageBase.Close() calls InternalClear(), which detaches the TestPage variable after every close attempt, allowed or refused, so a later Close() or field read raises 'The TestPage is not open.'. The runner's Cecil rewrite removes that detach and no-ops CheckPageOpened, so the variable keeps working. Measured by corpus PR StefanMaron/BusinessCentral.AL.Language.Tests#431, codeunit 60419; runner PR #4711 made the veto arms of that codeunit pass and left these for #4713.
